title: Slime Scions
statementMd:
A horrifying new species of slime was just discovered, the "tree slime". A normal slime splits into smaller slimes when it is killed. Tree slimes work differently.

On command, a tree slime of size $k  \gt  1$ will **spawn** 2 smaller tree slimes of size $k-1$; the larger tree slime remains unharmed in the process, though it can only do this once in its life. Those smaller tree slimes can also spawn 2 tree slimes of size $k-2$, until tree slimes of size 1 are spawned, which are the smallest possible tree slime and cannot spawn any smaller tree slimes.

Luckily, the scientists in the village have made a breakthrough. They've found that, if any of the tree slimes die, the tree slime they spawned from – the "parent" – also dies. So, if you hit a tree slime to kill it, then its parent will also die if it's still alive, and the parent's parent as well, and so on.

Suddenly, you hear a terrifying rumble. The village lookout spots a massive tree slime approaching the village. Right before your eyes, this tree slime and all of its descendants spawn all the tree slimes they possibly can. The lookout counts and says there is a line of $2^n$ size 1 tree slimes leading the charge, with all of the parent tree slimes following behind. The blacksmith has forged you a sword in a hurry, but it only has $h$ hits before it breaks. What's the maximum number of tree slimes you can kill?

*NOTE: Both the input and output may be large, make sure to use **64-bit integers*** (C/C++: `long long`, C#/Java: `long`, Python: doesn't matter)

## Input

The first and only line contains two space-separated integers, $n$ $(1 \le n \le 62)$ and $h$ $(1 \le h \le 2^n)$. This means there are $2^n$ size 1 tree slimes with all of their parents and parents' parents, etc, and you have $h$ hits before your sword breaks.

## Output

Print a single integer: the maximum number of tree slimes you can kill with $h$ hits of your sword.
statementZhMd:
发现了一种可怕的新型黏液怪物——“树形黏液怪”。普通黏液怪被杀死时会分裂成更小的黏液怪。而树形黏液怪的行为有所不同。

接到命令后，一个大小为 $k  \gt  1$ 的树形黏液怪会**生成** 2 个大小为 $k-1$ 的较小树形黏液怪；在此过程中，较大的树形黏液怪不会受到伤害，不过它一生只能进行一次这样的操作。这些较小的树形黏液怪也可以生成 2 个大小为 $k-2$ 的树形黏液怪，如此继续，直到生成大小为 1 的树形黏液怪。大小为 1 的树形黏液怪是可能存在的最小树形黏液怪，无法再生成更小的树形黏液怪。

幸运的是，村里的科学家取得了突破。他们发现，如果任意一个树形黏液怪死亡，那么生成它的树形黏液怪——“父代”——也会死亡。因此，如果你击打一只树形黏液怪将其杀死，那么只要它的父代还活着，父代也会死亡，父代的父代也会死亡，如此继续。

突然，你听到一阵可怕的轰鸣声。村里的瞭望员发现一只巨大的树形黏液怪正朝村庄靠近。就在你的眼前，这只树形黏液怪及其所有后代都生成了它们能够生成的全部树形黏液怪。瞭望员数了数，说有一列 $2^n$ 只大小为 1 的树形黏液怪正在最前方，所有父代树形黏液怪则跟在后面。铁匠匆忙为你锻造了一把剑，但剑在损坏前只能挥砍 $h$ 次。你最多能杀死多少只树形黏液怪？

*注意：输入和输出都可能很大，请务必使用 **64 位整数**（C/C++：`long long`，C#/Java：`long`，Python：不受影响）*

## 输入格式

唯一一行包含两个以空格分隔的整数 $n$ $(1 \le n \le 62)$ 和 $h$ $(1 \le h \le 2^n)$。这意味着有 $2^n$ 只大小为 1 的树形黏液怪，以及它们的所有父代、父代的父代等，并且你的剑在损坏前可以挥砍 $h$ 次。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数：使用剑挥砍 $h$ 次最多可以杀死的树形黏液怪数量。
